consistency.guarantee: All reads of this run (catalog metadata, sample, aggregation passes and deep checks) used one READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ snapshot, exported at the start of the run and imported by each table's own transaction; changes committed after it are not visible.

The size (pg_total_relation_size) describes the physical size at capture, not the snapshot.

consistency.guarantee: All reads of this run (catalog metadata, sample, aggregation passes and deep checks) used one READ ONLY REPEATABLE READ snapshot, exported at the start of the run and imported by each table's own transaction; changes committed after it are not visible.
notes: TRUNCATE and table-rewriting ALTER TABLE are not MVCC-safe: if they run concurrently, the snapshot can see the table as empty.
The size (pg_total_relation_size) describes the physical size at capture, not the snapshot.
